title: Italian Focaccia Bread
description: A classic Italian bread, perfect for snacking or serving with your favorite pasta dishes.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine yeast and warm water. Let it sit for 5-7 minutes until frothy.
2. Add flour, salt, and olive oil to the bowl. Mix until a shaggy dough forms.
3. Knead the dough on a floured surface for 10-12 minutes until smooth and elastic.
4. Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
6. Punch down the dough and shape it into a rectangle.
7. Place the dough on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
8. Dimple the dough with your fingers, then sprinkle with coarse salt.
9. Bake for 15-20 minutes until golden brown.
10. Remove from the oven and let it cool on a wire rack for 5 minutes before slicing.
